items.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》迄今为止的评论 - Beta 印象
items.summary: 30 hours with Forever's beta provides an optimistic start to a long journey.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/wow-forever-blogroll-1793833617221.jpg
Editor's Note: This initial review-in-progress is based entirely on time spent in the pre-release beta, and will be updated as we get deeper into into the full game.

I was there, Gandalf. I was there when the World of Warcraft opened its servers for the first time in 2004 – which might not literally be 10,000 years ago, but sometimes it feels like it. And now that I've put a good 30 hours into the beta for World of Warcraft: Forever, I'm looking forward to today's launch in a way I haven't for almost any game in a long time. GTA 6 can wait.

It may surprise you to hear me say that and then follow it up with the fact that I had essentially zero interest in World of Warcraft: Classic back in 2019. In fact, I wrote one of my favorite articles ever about exactly why that was. But Forever is different. It's built on the bones of Classic, but with just the right amount of modern sensibilities baked in. There are new zones to discover, much-needed class changes, and some truly impressive graphical enhancements. So, I invite you to come on this journey with me, as it's going to be a bit different from our typical game reviews.

The thing is, Forever is made to be savored. I almost didn't want to review it at all, given how deadline pressure can sometimes warp the experience of something this big. Blizzard really wants this new take on their storied MMO to be about the journey, not the destination – and we plan to honor that here. This will be more of a long-form critique that's going to hearken back to an old Blizzard motto from their golden age: It will be done when it's done. Anything less wouldn't be a review of World of Warcraft: Forever so much as a review of rushing through World of Warcraft: Forever in a stressful and unintended way.

As such, I plan to update this piece as I climb my way to level 60 and discover all the new things there are to discover at the sort of pace I think would make sense if I didn't have a hard deadline. I still expect to have some kind of a firmer verdict before everyone wanders off for the December holidays. But if you want to know whether I think it's worth jumping in right now, on launch day, I can start by sharing my impressions from the beta.
They Cooked

As an avid player of Modern WoW until very recently, and someone who skipped Classic altogether, it's almost a revelation to open up my character sheet in Forever and see 23 years of what I can only describe as "streamlinesh**tification" stripped away. Like, dang, this used to be so much more of an RPG! All the modern game's stat pruning, summary execution of mechanics that added character but were demonized as "inconvenient," class role homogenization, and so much more added up to a death by thousands of cuts that you almost wouldn't notice if you stayed subscribed from the beginning because it was generally so gradual.I love having features like parry, block, and hit chance back. I love leveling up my different weapon skills when I hit a new level. I love that we have more secondary stats to worry about than just crit, haste, versatility, and mastery. I even love having to go buy my skill ranks every level, because it makes me learn where the hub for my class is in each major city and meet the key NPCs I can hang with and look up to. I love that levelling actually takes a long time. This was important stuff that was slashed to try and create a frictionless slope that would never alienate anyone ever, and the modern game is much poorer for having lost it.

Azeroth is so much more interesting to explore on foot, too. Flying mounts are fun, especially with the post-Dragonflight skyriding system. (They are!) But zooming around through the air as the default mode of travel has taken so much of the character of exploration and discovery out of Modern. Forever insisting that you spend the first 40 levels without even the speed boost of a ground mount allowed me to reconnect with this world in ways that really made me feel 14 again. It feels big and dangerous and mysterious. It's wonderful.

And at this point, Forever's new lighting and post-processing make it look better than Modern to me. Yes, I do play with HD models. Sorry to all the SD purists, but I don't think the player races in particular actually hold up visually in 2026. I'm glad we can both pick the graphics we prefer. But regardless, these zones look stunning. They did go overboard with the fog in some areas, I think. But overall, I love the enhancements and going back to Modern feels like a straight downgrade.

I do have some concerns already. One of them is the "realmless" structure, which I think is particularly bad for roleplayers like me. We fought against capital cities having phasing in Modern for a good reason. Splitting up these hubs where people go to find RP tends to do the opposite of building strong communities. Blizzard has been swearing up and down that this is good for the long-term health of Forever. I am completely unconvinced so far, but willing to at least give it a chance.

It's hard to say too much more than that at this point. I ended my beta journey at level 13, gazing out across the dusty plains of Westfall, because I didn't want to spoil too much for myself before the big day. But from what I have seen so far? I think they might have done it. They made me believe I can go home again – and that home is somewhere I want to spend more time, with new surprises to discover. Let's see if they can keep it up for 47 more levels. Watch this space for updates in the weeks to come.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远的第一款新传奇武器揭晓
items.summary: Update: Blizzard has officially revealed it is, in fact, a new legendary weapon: Taldramir, the Whispering Woo

content.v: Update: Blizzard has officially revealed it is, in fact, a new legendary weapon: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood. Weta Workshop crafted a full-scale replica of the weapon in a video posted to the Warcraft Twitch stream. Original article is below.
World of Warcraft: Forever's launch is imminent, and Blizzard used the occasion to tease what looks to be the game's first new legendary weapon.

Earlier today, a stream went live on the Warcraft Twitch channel that shows the creation of what looks to be a full-scale night-elf-themed staff weapon. The name of the stream is titled Camelot_revealv2_final.mp4, with Camelot being a reference to Forever's development codename. Twitch itself is hyping up the stream, stating in a blog it will lead to a "major reveal and a particularly exciting moment you don't want to miss."

The builders on stream can be seen using 3D printers and all other kinds of tools to craft what looks like a life-size replica of a specific staff that has been popping up in recent Forever promotional materials. A staff wielded by a skyborne Druid that looks extremely similar to the one being built can be seen in the recent Warpath animated music video . New promotional Forever artwork on Battle.net also looks to feature the same, distinct staff, once again wielding by a skyborne Druid.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/WoW-Forever-New-Legendary-Weapon-1.jpg?w=636

In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast , a board in the background contained a night elf phrase that fans have roughly translated to something close to "The Hidden Blade is the guiding light." Given the words were written in the night elf language and that the staff that keeps appearing is also night-elf-themed, players are beginning to think the two are connected.

How players will find this new weapon remains to be seen, as are these classes that will be able to wield it. So far, it seems likely it will be a Druid weapon, but it's possible other staff-wielding classes could also acquire it.

Forever's raids don't unlock until December 9, but two of them, Hyjal Summit and the Barrow Downs, both have deep night-elf-lore connections. It seems plausible the staff will be related to these two raids in some way, but given how involved previous legendary weapon questlines in WoW Classic are, players shouldn't expect it to be a straightforward, easy, or quick process.

Whatever the reveal ends up being, we'll update this post once we know more. WoW: Forever launches today on PC, but sounds like it could come to other platforms in the future thanks to its controller support . In other Forever news, Blizzard looks to have teased new class and race combos that could come to the MMORPG in the near future.

items.title: 数据中心是昨晚美国中期选举中最大的输家之一
items.summary: Voters across the country opted for nearly every local ballot measure that would curb the rate of data center

content.v: On Tuesday, tens of millions of Americans voted in midterm elections to deliver a sweep of generational Democratic victories in federal and state races, reflecting a leftward electoral shift that's being interpreted as a nationwide rejection of Trumpism.

But even as Republican candidates and incumbents suffered defeats in what had traditionally been considered some of the party's most entrenched strongholds, the midterms also issued a stinging rebuke to another major source of voter frustration: Data centers. At nearly every opportunity, Americans voted in favor of local ballot measures to halt, slow, or stymie the pace of data center construction in their communities.

As tracked by Data Centers on the Ballot , across the 47 local midterm elections in the American cities and townships that featured ballot measures on data center construction, voters favored restrictions on the rate of data center expansion in 38 of the 39 completed counts. Of the eight races that remain open, voters supporting additional data center restrictions are leading in all six of the races with only partial reporting. For the two remaining races, no results have yet been posted.
Here's the rundown of the types of measures voters are supporting:

At time of writing, only one ballot measure that would have introduced data center restrictions failed: In Harwood, North Dakota, voters refused an amendment to the city charter that would have required Harwood to commission an independent review before approving new data center construction or expansion.

Aside from that one exception, it's not hard to suss out why so many of those measures have passed. NBC exit polls show that 56% of yesterday's midterm voters considered AI data centers either "crucial" or "a major factor" in their choice of Congress person, with data center opponents driven by concerns of environmental toll, energy costs, noise pollution, and—one must imagine—the upward-spiraling cost of RAM.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远可能刚刚偷偷地透露了新的职业和种族组合
items.summary: Developer Blizzard may have just revealed new World of Warcraft: Forever class and race combos less than a day

content.v: Developer Blizzard may have just revealed new World of Warcraft: Forever class and race combos less than a day before the game's launch.

Forever already features a number of new class and race combos not seen in WoW Classic, like troll Warlocks, human Hunters, and more. In a launch overview video diving into what players need to know about this new version of Blizzard's genre-defining MMORPG, however, eagle-eyed players noticed a few peculiar sights.

Along what appeared to be various class abilities that aren't currently in the game, certain class and race combinations that aren't currently possible can also be seen. A total of three new race and class combos are shown in the footage, including a tauren Mage casting frostbolt, a skyborne Paladin, and what appears to be a night elf Shaman (or at least a night elf wearing a Shaman armor set).

Those would each be big additions, particularly when it comes to more options for Paladin and Shaman players. Currently in Forever, only dwarves can be Shamans on the Alliance side of the MMO's faction divide, while the only Paladin option on Horde is undead. Having additional choices is never a bad thing, and a second Shaman option would likely be well received by the game's community.

Since skyborne can be either faction, this would give Horde players another race choice for Paladin, but could also ruffle some feathers. Skyborne are currently locked behind a $30 paywall, and some players might not take kindly to having a new paladin option cost additional cash.

Though it's certainly possible the new race and class combos seen in the launch overview video were included by mistake and no longer something Blizzard is planning, that seems unlikely given Blizzard's past comments.

While they won't be included in the game at launch, Blizzard has made clear they are something players should be expecting in the near future. In an interview with GameSpot last month, Forever associate production director Clay Stone said Blizzard was "holding back" some features that were originally planned for day one. He specifically said players can expect new class and race combos "not that far after launch."

WoW: Forever launches today for PC, but thanks to its controller support , it certainly sounds like it might be playable on other platforms in the future. Blizzard has made some big changes to Forever just in time for release, including a major damage boost for all classes and updates to racial abilities .

content.v: 任天堂Switch 2独占作品《塞尔达：时之笛 重制版》已在11月5日发售前解除评测禁令。截稿时，本作在OpenCritic和Metacritic的媒体平均分均为96，暂居两家网站的2026年游戏榜首。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793826025_634664_jpg_r.jpg
在OpenCritic历史榜单中，本作当时还以96分与《博德之门3》《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》并列第二，仅次于获得97分的《超级马力欧 奥德赛》。
本次重制以1998年原作为基础，重新制作画面与音频，并加入配音、便利性改进以及冲刺、跳跃等玩法调整。VGC和《卫报》均给出五星评价，前者肯定视觉翻新、更具电影感的叙事呈现及现代大片式规模；后者则明确表示，评论者自身会受到童年怀旧记忆影响。
RPG Site给出相对较低的8分，认为新画面和流畅操作进一步突出了原作优势，但批评部分用户界面设计，同时指出相关改动削弱了挑战感，使首领战显得过于简单。Skill Up没有打分，但推荐本作，并肯定新视觉与配音对叙事的强化，以及经典配乐经受住了时间考验。随着更多评测加入，两家网站的聚合分数仍可能发生变化。

items.summary: Epic Games在线服务产品总监Alexander Rehm认为，Valve目前应对Steam生成式AI仿制游戏的思路并不足以保护许多小型开发团队，尤其难以帮助仅有一两名成员、围绕单一创意机制开发作品的团队。Valv

content.v: Epic Games在线服务产品总监Alexander Rehm认为，Valve目前应对Steam生成式AI仿制游戏的思路并不足以保护许多小型开发团队，尤其难以帮助仅有一两名成员、围绕单一创意机制开发作品的团队。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793825769_100511_jpg_r.jpg
Valve近期调整了Steam审核流程，希望在增加要求的同时加快审核。平台仍要求开发者在商店页面披露AI使用情况，但不愿规定开发者可以采用哪些工具。Valve业务团队还建议开发者持续维护原创、高质量且难以复制的作品。
Rehm表示，这种做法或许适合资金和人员充足的团队，却可能让“持续改进”成为只有资源雄厚者才能承担的成本。他还批评Valve将AI使用者以仿制相威胁、向开发者索款的问题视为执法事务。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793826884_210601_jpg_r.jpg
争议也延伸至Epic Games自身。前Valve开发者Chet Faliszek指责Rehm曲解现场问答，并提到Epic的AI优先方向、相关活动，以及Epic游戏商城未设置与Steam相同的AI披露规则。Epic旗下Fab素材市场则因商业客户的合同需求，要求披露AI信息。争论的焦点仍是平台如何在不限制开发工具的情况下，处理抢先上线的近似作品并保护小型原创团队。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 法国游戏工会指责微软“破坏”Blade，然后利用其后果来证明关闭 Arkane 的合理性
items.summary: The STJV union says Microsoft imposed hiring freezes at Arkane that resulted in delays and additional expenses

content.v: France's Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo (STJV) union has accused Microsoft of sabotaging work on Marvel's Blade and then using the inevitable results to justify Arkane's closure.

The union said development of Blade "is going fine," and that the game is on par with Arkane's previous body of work, which includes the Dishonored series, Prey, Deathloop, and the sadly overlooked Dark Messiah of Might and Magic. Despite that, "workers have to face the harsh reality: our studio might get closed because, and only because, Microsoft decided to, even if that means sabotaging the game it funded."

"Microsoft chose to justify the closure on economic reasons," the union wrote. "But Microsoft is actually why those economic reasons even exist. Because after freezing hiring for 19 months, which artificially caused delays and additional cost, Microsoft now uses those same delays and additional costs as a reason to close down the studio."

Closing Arkane would defy "financial logic," the union claimed, as it would likely cost more money than just allowing it to finish Blade—and furthermore, it added, Arkane is profitable—"just not profitable enough for Microsoft."

"Microsoft is responsible for the situation Arkane is in today. Microsoft is responsible for the situation the workers are in today," the union said. "So Microsoft has to take full responsibility here and act accordingly."

While its "dearest wish" is to see Arkane "live on," STJV said the studio's future has to go beyond just completing Blade. And if that's not feasible and Arkane must close, it falls to Microsoft—"the company who decided that Arkane has to shut down"—to take care of the hundreds of lives it has thrown into turmoil. Given Microsoft's essentially limitless resources, the union believes the company has a moral obligation to go beyond the bare minimum required by law: "We will not allow the lives of Arkane Studios' workers to be destroyed without the company paying a fair price."
The union is not aiming low with its demands. First, "to give employees control over the decisions that shape their future" while acquisition negotiations are underway:
Should Arkane ultimately be closed, it demands Microsoft "funds commensurate with Microsoft’s status as a corporation" to ensure employees are properly compensated:

Those are big asks, but the union isn't wrong about the resources Microsoft has at its disposal: Microsoft's net income for the first quarter of FY27 was $36.6 billion. Xbox is a small contributor to that total, but it is a part of Microsoft, and that makes it Microsoft's issue to deal with.

For now, the fate of Arkane remains unresolved: The studio fell victim to the most recent round of cuts at Xbox , but a recent report indicated that it might yet find a home with a new owner . I've reached out to Xbox for comment on the STJV union's demands and will update if I receive a reply.

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》DMZ单人玩家可在第一赛季开始前反复执行一条搜刮路线，完整跑完约需10至15分钟。路线覆盖地图左侧六座导弹井附属地堡，途中还能顺路搜索机场北侧的军营。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792535596_272968_jpg_r.jpg

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793825482_436837_jpg_r.jpg
六座地堡至少对应六个武器柜，还可能找到背包、军用储物柜、脚柜、工具箱以及用于前线行动基地升级的贵重物品。进入军营时无需全面清敌，玩家可穿过南侧墙体缺口，再沿第一栋绿色建筑的外部楼梯抵达顶层房间，搜索其中的保险箱。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793825483_242621_jpg_r.jpg
执行路线时应尽快取得车辆，只处理目标地点，并在完成搜刮后就近撤离。路线作者在个人十次尝试中仅遇到一名玩家，但这一经历不能视为全程不会发生对抗的保证。
配装方面，玩家可以只携带一把武器并使用武器背包，为额外武器留出栏位；中型背包的安全栏则有助于带出配方或武器手册。第一赛季将于11月6日上线，届时玩家数量或战利品刷新均可能变化，这条路线因而具有明显时效性。

content.v: 《堡垒之夜》可能加入针对倒地玩家的动画终结动作。爆料者HYPEX称，Epic Games正在开发这项机制，但官方目前尚未正式公布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793824930_391288_jpg_r.jpg
按照爆料中的描述，发动终结动作后，执行者与倒地玩家都会进入一段同步动画。该系统能够容纳多种不同动画，还可能配套加入要求玩家“终结被击倒敌人”的任务。
这一设计被拿来与《使命召唤》长期采用的终结动作机制比较。《使命召唤》的不同动画通常会出现在装饰品组合包、流行文化联动或战斗通行证中，作为可解锁奖励。不过，现有消息只能说明《堡垒之夜》可能采用相似的交互方式，无法证明其动画获取或商业化方案也会照搬。
社交媒体用户vixenovaa猜测，终结动作可能成为第八章的“重大功能”，但这一说法尚未得到证实。Epic Games也没有公布上线日期、所属赛季、适用模式、动画获取方式及对战平衡规则，因此该功能目前仍停留在爆料阶段。

content.v: 《 上古卷轴6 ：哨兵》最新预告在结尾留下第四纪元206年的世界观引文，引发玩家对故事时间线的讨论。由于《上古卷轴5：天际》发生于第四纪元201年，部分玩家推测新作可能仅比前作晚五年。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793824886_326655.jpg
这段引文署名为落锤省女王Irande麾下的圣蛾祭司Yazar。若“五年后”的理解成立，《上古卷轴5：天际》中的龙裔事迹、内战走向，以及先祖神州对帝国和周边地区施加的压力，仍可能是泰姆瑞尔各地的近期记忆。
落锤省与天际、赛洛迪尔和高岩接壤，并已由帝国行省转为独立政治实体。这一背景也让玩家进一步讨论巨龙越境、地区贸易和政治冲突等可能性。
不过，第四纪元206年只能确认是引文的记录年份，无法证明游戏本篇发生于同一年。这段文字可能出自历史书籍，也可能是一则在更遥远未来才会应验的预言。
《上古卷轴5：天际》与《上古卷轴4：湮灭》的故事年代相隔约两百年，因此B社仍可能再次采用较大幅度的时间跳跃。“五年后”只是玩家根据预告文字作出的推测，官方尚未公布新作的故事时间线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 实际上不会很快上市
items.summary: Rockstar Games recently announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 will release in stores two days earlier than anticip

content.v: Rockstar Games has announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 will now released in stores two days earlier than anticipated--but this doesn't change anything about when you'll actually be able to play the game.
GTA 6's code-in-a-box physical edition will be available to purchase in stores starting on November 10; it was previously going to be November 12.

Rockstar also moved up the preloading date for GTA 6 from November 12 to November 10 for the digital and code-in-a-box versions. The developer offered no explanation as to why it made these changes, and the company did not respond to GameSpot's request seeking comment.

While you might walk into a Target or Best Buy or GameStop on November 10 and see a copy of GTA 6 that you can spend real money on, you cannot actually play the game until November 19 when the game goes live. If you're in the US, you'll be among the last people in the world to get in due to how the game is launching non-simultaneously .

Also in the post, Rockstar confirmed what everyone expected: The $100 Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 is not going to be sold in stores. This move, along with ditching discs entirely, is all about making money .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A recent poll said lots of people are excited to play GTA Online, but GTA 6 is a single-player game with no multiplayer component , at least not yet.

content.v: 《塞尔达：时之笛 重制版》首轮技术分析结果出炉。游戏绝大多数时候能够稳定维持60帧，整体画面也较为清晰，但FSR图像重建会让部分元素出现闪烁和视觉波动。

content.v: VAIA公布了一项面向游戏工作室的AI应用调查。94%的受访工作室已在九个游戏生产环节中的至少一个环节采用相关工具，但整体生产流程的整合程度中位数自评分仅为3分，满分为10分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793823517_788369_jpg_r.jpg
这项研究基于101场保密的一对一访谈，受访者均为工作室管理者或决策人员。访谈于2026年4月至9月进行，样本主要来自北美和欧洲。调查中，97%的受访者表示曾以某种形式使用AI，52%的参与者给所在工作室的流程整合程度打出3分或更低。
从具体用途来看，86%的受访工作室将AI用于编程和工程任务，83%用于提升一般工作效率，79%用于概念设计或前期制作。美术、资产和动画的采用率为60%，叙事及世界构建为55%，玩家数据分析和商业化环节的采用率更低。
区域数据也存在差异。欧洲管理者给出的整合深度平均分为4.2分，北美为3.5分；AI用于美术、资产和动画的比例分别为70%和53%。
Vivrato创始人亚当·博伊斯认为，仅询问工作室是否使用AI，已经不足以说明这项技术的实际作用，因为任务规划与直接生成最终成品内容之间存在明显区别。Vivrato同时销售AI整合报告及咨询服务；公司称调查结果经过独立行业分析师核查，但其商业利益以及以北美、欧洲为主的样本范围仍需纳入解读。

items.title: PUBG：绝地求生与韩国流行女团合作
items.summary: K-pop girl group IVE is bringing its hit song "Love Dive" to the PUBG, complete with themed locations, charact

content.v: PUBG: Battlegrounds is no stranger to unusual collaborations, but its latest might be one of its most unexpected yet. K-pop girl group IVE is bringing its hit song Love Dive to the battle royale shooter, complete with themed locations, character skins, choreography, and music videos — further proof there is no scenario that cannot be improved with a bit of K-pop.

The collaboration is live now on PC and arrives on console November 12, bringing three special IVE locations across Rondo, all inspired by the Love Dive music video, including the IVE Mansion. We're also getting all six members represented with character likenesses, outfits, accessories, and weapon and gear skins. Across six maps, Rondo, Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Deston, and Vikendi, there are special IVE Emote Stages where you can perform one of the special IVE emotes to see a music video (on PC) or some album artwork on console. You can also look forward to Cupid's Crossbow and Cupid Chicken Man "interactive elements" on starting islands.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/04/pubg-battlegrounds-x-ive-cosmetics-1793811071818.jpg

If you haven't yet discovered the total joy that is a good K-pop bop, the update also has something for players who prefer their PUBG experience with slightly less choreography and significantly more suffering. Two previous PvE modes are returning with increased difficulty.

HLB: Dawnbreakers of Rondo will get more frequent enemies, additional fuel requirements, and weaker defensive objectives and runs from November 4 to 25 on PC and November 12 to December 3 on consoles.

Returning roguelite mode Xeno Point: Hell trades the three OG difficulty levels for a single Hell difficulty and adds a tougher fourth sector. That mode runs from November 18 to December 2 on PC and November 26 to December 10 on console.

Whether you're dropping into Rondo for the chicken dinners or the choreography, PUBG's latest update certainly offers something a little different. I'm starting a petition for a Stray Kids collaboration immediately.

items.title: GTA 6 的下载量很大，但您可能有资格获得免费速度提升以加快下载速度
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and the game's file size, 212GB , is truly massive. One internet c

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and the game's file size, 212GB , is truly massive. One internet company, Spectrum, is turning this into a marketing moment for its own services by offering members a "free Gig Speed Lift" in November to help download the game faster.

Available November 9-30, the offer has "no cost and no strings attached," the company said. The offer is fairly straightforward: Customers with a qualifying internet plan and compatible equipment can use the My Spectrum app to opt in. Then on November 9, customers will have their download speeds upped to 1Gbps. If you're already on a plan offering that, you'll get boosted to 2Gbps.
Spectrum said the boost should allow people to download GTA 6 in under 30 minutes.

The free upgrade offer runs through November 30, so that also covers Thanksgiving, when you might have a bunch of people in your home and want faster internet. It also covers the Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping holidays.

After November 30, the speed boost gets pulled from your account with no further action required on your part. The whole idea here is that Spectrum thinks you'll enjoy it so much that you'll pay to upgrade on a more permanent basis.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. For more, check out the exact GTA 6 worldwide release times to find out when it unlocks where you live.

items.title: GTA 6 调查显示人们确实想要 GTA Online，但尚未得到证实
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, and a lot of people are very excited to play some kind of online m

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, and a lot of people are very excited to play some kind of online mode, according to a new study. The only problem is that GTA 6 is a strictly single-player game and has no online mode, at least not one that Rockstar has talked about yet.

Research firm Piper Sandler recently polled 9,000 teenagers , with 90% saying they intend to play GTA Online. It would be shocking if GTA 6 doesn't eventually have an online mode, but the company has not said anything about that.
Product listings for GTA 6 at retailers make it clear that the game is a "single-player experience," so it's not something Rockstar is trying to be coy about.
The poll also found that 40% of respondents said they planned to make additional in-game purchases.

Additionally, the survey found that 70% of respondents who own a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S plan to buy GTA 6. Of those, 55% said they are planning to buy GTA immediately, and 15% said they would wait several months.
Before this, Circana reported that nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6 ; that's the highest purchase intent that Circana has ever measured.

Analyst James Callahan reiterated a $290 price target on Take-Two's stock. After getting crushed so far in 2026, Take-Two stock today stands at about $210/share (after a huge rally today, November 4).
It remains to be seen what Rockstar may do with the existing GTA Online for GTA 6 after GTA 6 comes out--whatever the case, gamers are going to be mad .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading starts on November 10 , and gamers in the US will be among the last in the world to get to play the game , so maybe pack your bags for New Zealand .

items.title: 前光环作曲家马蒂·奥唐纳 (Marty O'Donnell) 输掉选举，然后遭到对手的攻击：“战斗结束了”
items.summary: Susie Lee has clearly been waiting for this moment.

content.v: It was a big night for Democrats in the US, as a "blue wave" saw the party retake control of Congress in what CNN called "a stunning blow to Trump." Among the night's big losers is former Halo composer Marty O'Donnell, whose run for Congress ended in a spectacular, crushing defeat—and then a dunk from his congressional opponent that can only be described as brutal .

O'Donnell began his political career in 2024, saying he "never wanted to be a politician" but felt compelled to do so by what he described as the deterioration of the US: "Big tech, big pharma, big media, big whatever—all trying to control big government in Washington DC."

That effort didn't work out so well—he placed fourth in the 2024 Republican primary for Nevada's third congressional district—but he tried again in 2026, this time with the support of US president Donald Trump , which O'Donnell enthusiastically welcomed despite previously calling Trump an "idiot." Well, winds and tides change.
Anyway, O'Donnell won the 2026 Republican primary, and then got in the ring with Susie Lee, the Democrat incumbent who's held the seat since 2019. It did not go well for him.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nf26cRu4zaq3s8bg5a2jPo-1920-80.png
Hey, that happens sometimes—you think you got it, and then it turns out you don't actually got it at all.

But O'Donnell's Trump-toned campaign, complete with dire warnings about open borders, Marxism and the woke left, accusations of corruption leveled against Lee, embrace of the far-right commentariat, and occasional asides to remind everyone that he's absolutely not mad about being fired by Bungie , did not exactly endear him to his political opponents, or very many other people, really.
So after dismantling O'Donnell, the re-elected Lee—who seemed to largely ignore O'Donnell's rhetoric during the campaign—sent him off into the sunset with this:
Enjoy your retirement @MartyTheElder https://t.co/vH8KwKWrdl November 4, 2026
I'm just a bystander on the scene—I'm not even American, much less a Democrat cheerleader. But holy cow . You can see that crater from orbit.
O'Donnell did not take Lee's farewell particularly well, which led to even more smoke in the comments.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3hv4AYWtgRyEBt8DHx579A-1920-80.png
I think this is one of those times were you have to just take it on the chin and move along. We'll see how that goes.

items.title: 《最终幻想 7：启示录》制作人北濑佳典暗示史克威尔艾尼克斯对电影改编和新游戏感兴趣
items.summary: Yoshinori Kitase, producer of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Trilogy and director of the original Final Fantasy

content.v: https://assets2.ignimgs.com/2004/12/10/final-fantasy-vii-advent-children-20041209065803479-1007040.jpg

Yoshinori Kitase, producer of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Trilogy and director of the original Final Fantasy VII, was optimistic about the possibility of more movie adaptations for Final Fantasy games and hinted that Square Enix is likely interested in pursuing original IP moving forward.

It seems like every major video game developer is hawking out their IP for TV and film adaptations these days. And, for the most part, many of these have been quite successful: Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie has become one of the most profitable horror films of all time, and the Sonic film franchise is so popular that a fourth movie is on the way.

One developer that’s been notably absent from this trend is Square Enix. While the Final Fantasy games have had their fair share of adaptations over the years to mixed reception from fans ( The Spirits Within is a good movie, dammit, and I’ll die on this hill), we haven’t seen one on the big screen in quite some time.

IGN’s Michael Peyton got the chance to speak with Yoshinori Kitase at the Lucca Comics & Games Festival 2026, where he asked about Square Enix’s plans for future movies. And while Kitase couldn’t tell us much, his response was optimistic.

“Given the fact that we created this game, the remake of Final Fantasy VII, which explored the world of Final Fantasy VII way more than the original version, I think that it would be nice to have in the future games or TV series inspired by the story of Final Fantasy. And I don't see why that should not be a possibility in the future,” he answered.

What’s more, Kitase also seemed to be under the impression that Square Enix is likely to pivot its focus toward more original stories and IP, following the massive effort that is the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy .

“I think that mainly, we are more likely to invest in new titles and new games, but at the same time, for example, this time with the [Final Fantasy VII] remake, there was me and other creators who worked on the original game, which we had really strong feelings towards,” he said. “And we really wanted to create something new related to the old game to allow new users to play and to know the appeal of this game as much as the old users who play the old game. So there might be different cases like this one where the company is willing to invest in remaking old projects and other kinds of games like it happened this time.”

The third and final game in the Remake trilogy, Final Fantasy VII Revelation , releases on April 28, 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC. For more information about the game, check out our hands-on preview from October, where we got the chance to play a section early and get a better feel for what the next chapter of Cloud’s journey will be like. You can read our full interview with Yoshinori Kitase here.

items.title: 我回来改装《GTA 5》并被十亿只愤怒的武装美洲狮追赶
items.summary: I missed this.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

We are back. After a long sojourn to the centre of the self, I return—having completed a journey of discovery where I reflected on what I really wanted from modding GTA 5: my true desires, true capabilities, and where I want to take this whole thing as we walk, together, into the future. I speak to you now of the wisdom I have gained from my vagabond travels, behold:
I've put roving packs of hostile cougars in the game now.

The mod to put loads of cougars in Grand Theft Auto 5 is called Cougars , which is easy to remember, and it boasts "seven special cougar types" and four difficulties. Cougar time is initiated with a tap of the delete key, at which point you may choose either Catnap, Furmidable, Feral, or Catastrophe mode, which I am led to believe affects the volume of the cat hordes dispatched against you and the potency of their armaments.

Naturally, I opted for Catastrophe, kicking off a sort of pseudo-game-show opening where Franklin, Trevor, Michael, and Franklin's celebrity bodyguard were all fleeing angry litters of cats. Then we were off, with me—as Franklin—desperately dodging leaping cougars, some of them armed with heavy machine guns, some wearing body armour, some with traffic cones for reasons known only to God. Then I teleported, and the cougars followed me.

This process continued for a few minutes before I realised that, most likely, I was not going to reach my goal of a private jet waiting on the runway at Los Santos International. I performed a rare purposeful teleport to bring myself home, at which point about 56 quintillion cougars attempted to kill me. I solved this problem with an explosive micro-SMG.

When I boarded the plane, I was told I had won, and a man with a cougar for a head and a parade of dancing regular cougars behind him all congratulated me. I teleported away in the middle of their performance. It is good to be back.

items.title: IGN 好评最多的 Nintendo Switch 2 游戏
items.summary: Not all Nintendo games are created equal. Here are the 15 best Nintendo games we've played in the Switch 2 gen

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/01/23/switch2games-1769208267817.jpg

The Switch 2 launched just over a year ago, and we've already gotten our hands on some excellent games . If you're looking for recommendations of what to play on the newest console, we've compiled every Nintendo game that we've given a review score of 8 or above.

While there are tons of amazing games that have already been released on or ported over to the Switch 2, we’re setting some limits by sticking to Nintendo exclusives. These are predominantly first-party games published by Nintendo for either just the Switch 2 or both Switch consoles.
Let’s get into it.
10/10 - Masterpiece
Donkey Kong Bananza
Release Date: July 17, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: " The leader of the bunch is finally back to kick some tail in Donkey Kong Bananza, a brilliant successor to Super Mario Odyssey and a smashing return for a classic Nintendo character. It was a bold choice to build the Switch 2’s first 3D platformer around Donkey Kong instead of Mario, but it’s proven to be the best decision Nintendo could’ve made. DK’s satisfying, expressive movement and powerful, dynamic abilities create a truly groundbreaking adventure." - Logan Plant
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Switch 2 Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/02/08/legend-of-zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom-1663081213439-1675804568959-1675893074772.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Original Review or Switch 2 Review Update

From IGN's Review Update: "Not only does The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom still hold up as a game I can’t wait to lose a few dozen more hours in, the updates and additions made to the Switch 2 Edition make it feel like this is the way it was always meant to be played." - Tom Marks
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Switch 2 Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2020/10/26/01-tloz-botw-1603741775621.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Original Review or Switch 2 Review Update

From IGN's Review Update: "This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is of course an enhanced version with visual upgrades, faster loading times, and support for the Zelda Notes service via the Nintendo Switch App on your mobile device. It’s admittedly a fairly modest upgrade in terms of actual new features or content, but a welcome one, and it makes this undoubtedly the best way to play a sprawling epic that still stands tall as one of the greatest achievements in Nintendo’s iconic adventure series." - Tristan Ogilvie
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/qzuax40lrolrujuasopx3speeoyx-g-f0ehbrw8ebkw-1789527124260.jpeg
Release Date : September 17, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review : "Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave builds upon its strategic arts in ways I couldn’t have anticipated. It’s never satisfied to make me grow only as a battlefield tactician, or only in my ability to manage my time between skirmishes wisely, but both in perfect harmony. Every time I turned around, I was being given more challenges to face and more tools to master in order to overcome them. The many unique twists of each hero’s story path had me eager to see all the ways those journeys differed from each other, making the grand culmination in the final act hit so damn well. Planning out my expeditions across an imposing map became an unexpected highlight that not only hooked me, but rewarded my persistence by continuing to expand all the ways I could direct my armies as I tried to stay on top of newly emerging threats. The scope of both its formidably challenging battles and intricate management systems would be wildly ambitious for one path, let alone spread across four – yet somehow Fortune’s Weave only gets better and better each time you guide its captivating heroes into the colosseum and far beyond." - Brendan Graeber
9/10 - Amazing
Splatoon Raiders
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/20/splatoonraiders-blogroll-02-1784569680712.jpg
Release Date: July 23, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Splatoon Raiders is an amazing action RPG with an expertly executed loop. It has fantastic new powers with crazy upgrades that are worth chasing, tough battles that force you to put care into your build in order to overcome them, and a huge variety of fun level types to jump between. The pacing, balance, and difficulty curve are very impressive: I always had to work to get better, but none of the campaign ever felt like grinding or needless padding." - Logan Plant
Pokemon Pokopia
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/02/28/pokemon-pokopia-blogroll-01-1772238090766.jpg
Release Date: March 5, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Pokémon Pokopia is a real treat: an enjoyable building and town simulator that capitalizes on the charming personalities of its monsters in a way that appeals to both the creative and collector alike. It's packed with fun things to do and worthy rewards for doing them, and strikes a healthy balance between freedom and suggestion in its building mechanics (despite a few precision nitpicks)." - Rebekah Valentine
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/zelda-ocarinaoftime-review-blogroll-1793749976079.jpg
Release Date: November 5, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Two eras intertwine in the The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake: Nintendo skillfully melds the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own." - Logan Plant
8/10 - Great
Mario Kart World
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/11/1158164-mario-kart-world-un-jeu-de-course-inedit-et-plein-de-nouveautes-annonce-pour-la-nintendo-switch-2-1781165564781.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "The first brand-new Mario Kart in a decade makes huge changes to the established formula, but ironically, the best parts about it closely follow the blueprint of every entry that’s come before: unbeatable local multiplayer racing on well-designed tracks that more than live up to the series’ legacy. World’s tight controls, celebratory soundtrack, and universal polish marvelously complement the action, and I can’t wait to see how top players will take full advantage of its exciting parkour mechanics in the months and years ahead." - Logan Plant
Pokemon Legends: Z-A
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/10/13/pokemonlegendsza-review-blogroll-1760397288813.jpg
Release Date: October 16, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Pokemon Legends: Z-A finally feels like Game Freak hitting its stride in Pokemon’s 3D era. Lumiose City may not be visually exciting, but exciting Pokemon encounters, well-written characters, and amusing side quests still make it fun to explore while also serving as the ideal vehicle for a more intimate and emotionally mature Pokemon story." - Rebekah Valentine
Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/13/hyrulewarriors-1778704729327.jpg
Release Date: November 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom left a lot of unanswered questions perfect for exploring in a prequel, but Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment isn’t all that interested in answering them. What it is interested in is weaving together iconic mechanics from its source material to deliver the best musou action the series has seen yet. It constantly rewards your knowledge of Tears of the Kingdom through clever, often hilarious movesets that recontextualize abilities to fit its over-the-top action, as well as smaller payoffs like boss weaknesses that are consistent across the pair of games." - Logan Plant
Kirby Air Riders
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/13/kirbythumbono-1763069064246.jpg
Release Date: November 20, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "I’m not sure what’s crazier: the fact that Kirby Air Riders exists, or the fact that it’s this great. It’s a blast in local or online multiplayer during its traditional races and unique battle mode, and its frankly absurd amount of fun achievements to chase, meaningful unlockables, and deep customization makes it great for solo players, too." - Logan Plant

items.title: New Blood 首席执行官宁愿关闭婴儿潮一代射击工作室也不愿出售：“20 年后，我们就完蛋了。”我要说再见了，把它关掉吧”
items.summary: "I want us to have a happy ending. I want us to go out on our terms."

content.v: New Blood Interactive has been around for more than a decade—it's celebrating its 12 year anniversary, in fact—and is still going strong. Dusk, Gloomwood, Amid Evil, Fallen Aces, Ultrakill—it's got an enviable catalogue that continues to grow. But CEO Dave Oshry is still imagining how it might end.

By keeping the studio relatively small, letting everyone work remotely, and not putting all its eggs in a franchise basket and spitting out endless sequels, it's been able to keep doing its thing. And that's the only way Oshry wants it to work.

"If we couldn't be successful doing it this way, I wouldn't want to do it at all," he tells us. "Rather than scrambling to find publisher money or investor money, I'd rather just shut it down and be like, 'We tried, we did our best, we made some cool games, that was it.' And I still want to do that. People are like, 'What's the end look like?' And I'm like, 'In 20 years, we're done. I'm gonna say goodbye, shut it down. Thanks for playing our games. That was fun. I'm gonna go fishing now.'"

Should New Blood start to struggle, Oshry has no interest in selling it to keep it alive. "I'm never gonna sell it. I'm never gonna give it to anybody else. It'll be our time." He'll be content, he says, if people remember its games fondly. "I hope people remember us like their favourite game studios from the '90s or 2000s. Except I don't want us to have the shitty ending like a lot of those studios had, where they got acquired or they went out of business. I want us to have a happy ending. I want us to go out on our terms."

It's a promise that hits a lot harder these days, with so many studios getting gobbled up and then being tossed aside. As October came to a close, EA killed off BioWare after years of mismanagement. 30 years down the drain. Like countless studios that have been acquired by the likes of EA, Microsoft and Embracer, there was no happy ending.
Oshry describes the games industry as "a machine that requires product and labour, and that's not us". Instead, he prefers to think of New Blood as a band.

"Our games are our albums. We tour, we sell merchandise, and everybody plays their part. We're like an orchestra now, actually, more than a band. Because we got a lot of people, and a lot of musically inclined people. We're like the Trans-Siberian Orchestra at this point.

"Eventually the band's gonna get old, and we're gonna get tired, and we're gonna do our retirement tour, and we're gonna call it a day before we get sad. Before we're on stage and people are like, 'Ah, they're getting a little long in the tooth. They can't hit those high notes anymore.' So before that happens, I want to shut it down and enjoy my life."

items.title: Nexus Mods 采用 Valve 的方法来处理人工智能生成的内容：没有彻底禁止，但强制披露
items.summary: And it says it already knows not everyone will play nice.

content.v: Nexus Mods, the world's largest mod site and more or less a second home for anyone who's ever installed a Bethesda game, has new rules regarding AI-generated and AI-assisted mods on its platform. In short, it's taking a Steam-ish approach: no outright bans on AI content, but it's compulsory to disclose where it's been used in your mods, and to what extent.

"An outright ban will not eliminate AI from the modding process but will prevent people from mentioning its use", wrote Nexus owner Victor 'Foledinho' Folmann in an update yesterday. "We'd prefer the opposite; it should be out in the open, clearly labelled, and regulated according to the rules that we can implement on our platform".

So, starting yesterday, modders uploading new projects to Nexus will have to tick a box declaring how much AI was used in their work, including promotional materials. They can declare their mods "AI-generated", which is to say mostly produced by AI; "AI assisted", for mods that are mostly human-made with a little LLM assistance on the side; or declare them free of the tech's touch altogether.

"AI assisted" modders will also have to make public explanations as to where and how AI has been used, in addition to the box-ticking. The tags will be shown more prominently—right after adult-content tags.

Meanwhile, Nexus itself is pledging never to use mods to train AI or to sell them to third parties that want to do so. The site is also introducing new permissions that will let authors declare whether they are open to (non-Nexus) parties using their creations for AI use and training, with the default being "Ask Me".

How long does everyone have to get themselves in-line with the new rules? Glad you asked. "We'll also be introducing a 60-day grace period for existing mods to meet the new requirements, giving Mod Authors time to review their mods and make any necessary changes to them. This grace period starts today (3rd November 2026) and ends on 2nd January 2027."

I was a little unsure as to whether the new rules would truly apply to every mod on Nexus. There are a lot of them, after all, and plenty that have long since been abandoned by their original creators. Nevertheless, Nexus tells me that "it applies to every mod uploaded to the site, including ones that were uploaded prior to our announcement and the grace period." So better get your ducks in a row, mod authors.

Anyway, will every modder using AI dutifully hew to these rules? No, but Nexus says it knows that. "While we hope these changes will encourage everyone to disclose their AI usage, to be honest, that’s not going to happen. Additionally, we are putting clear moderation standards in place, enforced with consequences for breaking the rules", says Folmann. We'll see how it all shakes out in the months to come.

items.title: Nexus Mods 不会禁止 AI Mods，但也不会让它们隐藏
items.summary: Nexus Mods owner Victor "Foledinho" Folmann has outlined plans to make AI disclosures mandatory for PC mods up

content.v: Nexus Mods owner Victor "Foledinho" Folmann has outlined plans to make AI disclosures mandatory for PC mods uploaded to the site. While content built with AI tools won't be banned--despite it being a contentious subject in the modding community--Folmann did reveal that Nexus Mods will ultimately require modders to clearly communicate when AI has been used.

"We already have tags for AI-generated and AI-assisted mods, but we recognize that there’s a lot more we can do to make that information more accessible and clear for you all," Folmann wrote . "As of today, we're making AI disclosure mandatory when uploading a new mod, meaning mod authors will need to declare whether AI has been used in their work. All existing mods will have one of two popups: a persistent one when editing a mod in the upload form, and a dismissible one on the 'My Mods' page."

At the same time, Nexus Mods users will be able to filter out AI-produced mods entirely from their search results, similar to what Itch.io does as part of its efforts to combat AI spam uploads. As for why Nexus Mods will allow AI content to remain on the site, Folmann added that an outright ban would likely lead modders to simply not declare their use of AI tools in their mod-creation-efforts. By allowing and moderating it, the site can motivate users to be more transparent.

"An outright ban will not eliminate AI from the modding process but will prevent people from mentioning its use. We'd prefer the opposite; it should be out in the open, clearly labelled, and regulated according to the rules that we can implement on our platform," Folmann wrote. "Mod authors should have a chance to decide about the further use of their work, and you should be able to decide for yourselves how much AI-based content you want to see, whether more, less, or no content at all."

Nexus Mods' official stance is that it will not use mods to train AI, nor will it sell or license them out, Folmann added. The site will continue to fine-tune its approach to AI-assisted mods while also punishing anyone caught breaking its new disclosure rules.
AI has been a hot-button issue lately for PC gamers, with the recent Steam Next Fest highlighting a growing problem of slop flooding the platform.

Game developers have also reported that the mandatory QA check every game must pass before launch is taking even longer now, with studios blaming a deluge of AI-generated games for slowing down the process. This week, Steam announced new game submission rules to get things back on track, including requiring developers to ensure their game can run through the Steam Client for at least five minutes before they hit the submit key.

items.title: “什么都没有了，价格怎么可能下跌呢？” TeamGroup首席执行官认为内存供需平衡最早要到2028年底才能实现
items.summary: "Right now you can still buy goods, they're just expensive. In a little while, you may not be able to buy good

content.v: You may well be sick of reading about it—I am certainly sick to my stomach writing about it—but here's another doom-filled prophecy about the continuing memory crisis. Doesn't seem quite so funny calling it a RAMpocalypse now. The CEO of memory module maker TeamGroup, Chen Ching, is claiming we still haven't seen the worst of the supply crisis, and that even in 2027 "there will be no downward price trend whatsoever."

According to a report from BigGo Finance , which cropped up while I was searching for a credible source after mydrivers wrote about it, Chen thinks the worst of the shortage will be from now until the middle of next year, and that we're likely to get to a point with DRAM that "even money can't buy goods".
"Right now you can still buy goods, they're just expensive," he says. "In a little while, you may not be able to buy goods at all."

This is all on the back of an earnings call for the company, where it announced record quarterly revenue of NT$10.139 billion (around $308 million), which is an increase of 34% compared with last quarter.

TeamGroup, like most memory manufacturers looking to capitalise on the current crisis, is prioritising where it can get the most cash from, and that comes from selling direct to data centre and enterprise folk, rather than us normies. Just as chatty Sam Altman would like it to be. Fully two thirds of TeamGroup's business is now selling into other businesses, where previously that percentage was just a quarter, with the majority going into the consumer market.

Chen claims its relationships with vendors will help it continue to get inventory, even if it has to pay premium spot prices for it. But he notes that supply will continue to be the big problem, suggesting that supply and demand equilibrium is unlikely to be achieved any time before the second half of 2028, or potentially even later.
And, obviously, that means prices will remain high, or more likely keep rising. "How can prices fall when there's nothing left?" he questions like a good little doom-monger. Good 'ere, innit?

items.title: 我正在我的 Steam Frame 上观看绚丽立体 3D 的 YouTube 视频，只需要一个免费插件和一个早已被遗忘的新任天堂 3DS 梦想
items.summary: It sorta looks like it's in three dimensions!

content.v: Remember the 3D craze? The Nintendo 3DS, 3D TV, 3D cinema; it was a new, exciting technology that some expected would go mainstream one day. Then the dream just sorta died. People don't talk about it much these days; except for this wonderful project that takes normal videos and turns them, alchemy-like, into slightly more 3D-looking videos using the Steam Frame .
And let me tell you, it's actually pretty good.
It's called framedepth , and it's made by a user going by guix8 on GitHub. It's a plugin for Chrome that adds a stereoscopic 3D effect to any video when viewed via the browser on the Steam Frame.

It's surprisingly fun. I've been watching live gigs and eating challenges on YouTube and the stereoscopic effect is automatically applied once enabled via the extension. It definitely adds some extra level of immersion to it. Not much, but some. I wouldn't go as far to say I felt like I was there in the crowd for either spectacle, and maybe I wouldn't want to be in the firing line of a food challenge, but it's better than I thought it would be. An ever-so-slightly more engaging way to watch YouTube in VR.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tkKHSCh9PgYnVcJuY5mnk-1920-80.jpg

The installation process is a bit more involved than your average Chrome plugin, requiring the Steam Frame to be in developer mode. You need to install Chrome on the Steam Frame, which requires a quick trip to the SteamOS desktop to run the Konsole and install via Flathub (flatpak install com.google.Chrome). Then you have to download framedepth from the GitHub and whack more code in the terminal:
cd ~/Downloads && f=$(ls -v framedepth-*-steamos-arm64.tar.gz | tail -1) && echo "$f" # the newest download
sha256sum -c "$f.sha256" && tar -xzf "$f" && cd "${f%.tar.gz}"
bash install.sh # ~/.local/share/framedepth, user service, extension files

Finally, it needs to be loaded as an extension into Chrome, which also requires developer mode to be enabled for extensions in the browser. Once installed, you can enable the 3D effect and change the settings from a dropdown menu right there in Chrome.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MZYj7cXwYVmpDezX3zDBc-1920-80.jpg
The pop-out slider to the max seems to have the most impact on the 3D effect; the equivalent of cranking the 3DS slider all the way up.
There's a bunch to play around with here, but it's worth a go if you have a Steam Frame. If anything, just to rekindle lost excitement for 3D technologies that never managed to win us all over.

items.title: 《黎明杀机》在向 TheBurntPeanut 赠送 DLC 后向粉丝道歉，并“删除了授予的内容”
items.summary: "We can take the heat!" Are you sure about that?

content.v: Dead by Daylight's devs have found themselves in hot water and in the middle of quite a mess. In short, over the Halloween weekend a team member saw TheBurntPeanut playing Dead by Daylight, not in a sponsored stream I may add, and gifted him free DLC, items, and currency.

All the Dead by Daylight DLCs combined come to $335/£301: a substantial sum to just give away to a streamer who makes more money than most of us will see in a lifetime. TheBurntPeanut did then offer to give back all the content and said that he was willing to pay for it, but the official response from an official Dead by Daylight account on his stream was, "We can take the heat. They are yours to keep."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DTbEJetjxufGz2RDTGv7Z-1920-80.jpg

This turned out to be untrue, as shortly after the stream Dead by Daylight rescinded this offer. In an official social media post the devs explained: "we have already removed the content that was granted to the creator".

So what went wrong? Well, gifting hundreds of dollars worth of free stuff to a wealthy content creator who isn't undertaking a sponsored stream isn't a fantastic look. But the DBD community were more annoyed about the conflict in values . Something that the Dead by Daylight creator has now acknowledged:

"When collaborating with a new creator, we normally look thoroughly at their past content to determine whether they are representing the values of inclusion our community expects from us. In this case, this was not taken into proper consideration or discussed as a group.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MRMnTBptizV9QupEg2wYRS-1920-80.jpg

"When we talk about our values in relation to our community, we mean respect, transparency, diversity, and creating a space where people from different backgrounds and experiences feel welcome. Diversity is one of DBD's core principles and everyone is welcome to play it. But when we choose to work with a creator, we're putting our name next to theirs, and we want to partner with creators whose words and actions share and support that principle."

They have also confirmed that there will be updated request and approval methods for this kind of thing going forward to ensure "any Dead by Daylight spokesperson is properly representing our team and our values."
